suite: Routine original-account write attempt browser recovery
environment: local built Worker, local D1, synthetic data
limits: Actual local built Worker/native D1 and Chromium with synthetic principals.
Native audit faults and declared browser-wire header/network faults only; no global ACL, full NFR, physical-device, clinical/UAT or hosted acceptance.
Recovery retained only in the mounted page; no durable device recovery claim.
